_comment: Kraktooth goblin gear matrix (task-513). Emitted by tools/gen_library_items.py. Category supplies defaults; the entry overrides. Deferred from the source matrix (needs a new mechanic or is covered by an existing generic template): partial-armor sub-slots map onto the coarse slots with description flavor; wire/nails/screws/springs/gears/washers/glue/pitch are one shared material kit, not per-goblin clones; salt/spices are existing generic staples; concealed-carry is task-516 and ammunition is task-518.

kraktooth_belt.name: Kraktooth Belt
kraktooth_belt.description: A wide scrap-leather belt punched with holes for hanging tools, trophies and pouches.

kraktooth_pouch.name: Scrap-Leather Pouch
kraktooth_pouch.description: A soft pouch of mismatched leather, cinched shut with a bone toggle.

kraktooth_rope.name: Coarse Rope
kraktooth_rope.description: A hank of frayed rope knotted from whatever fibre the camp could scavenge.

kraktooth_hooks.name: Bent Iron Hooks
kraktooth_hooks.description: A bundle of hand-bent iron hooks, good for climbing, hanging meat or prying.

kraktooth_bone.name: Bone Offcuts
kraktooth_bone.description: Knuckles, splinters and offcuts saved from every kill for tools and charms.

kraktooth_metal_scrap.name: Metal Scrap
kraktooth_metal_scrap.description: A sack of bent nails, torn sheeting and human-made fragments.

kraktooth_cloth.name: Scrap Cloth
kraktooth_cloth.description: Torn strips of cloth in a dozen faded colors, washed and rewound.

kraktooth_leather.name: Scrap Leather
kraktooth_leather.description: Offcuts and strips of tanned hide, some still stinking of the tanning pit.

kraktooth_feathers.name: Feathers
kraktooth_feathers.description: A tied bundle of feathers in barred greys and browns, for arrows and trinkets.

kraktooth_coins.name: Goblin Coins
kraktooth_coins.description: A pouch of clipped, dented coins sorted by shine rather than by face value.

kraktooth_glass_bits.name: Glass Bits
kraktooth_glass_bits.description: Colored shards of glass saved from broken windows and bottles, edges dulled by handling.

zikka_patchwork_vest.name: Patchwork Leather Vest
zikka_patchwork_vest.description: A vest sewn from a dozen different hides, seams staggering where it has been mended.

zikka_leather_leg_wraps.name: Leather Leg Wraps
zikka_leather_leg_wraps.description: Strips of hide wound tight from knee to ankle, bound with cord.

zikka_shoulder_plate.name: Scavenged Shoulder Plate
zikka_shoulder_plate.description: A curved plate of stolen human metal strapped over one shoulder.

zikka_heavy_boots.name: Heavy Goblin Boots
zikka_heavy_boots.description: Squat boots soled with layered scrap, scarred by years of stony ground.

zikka_cleaver.name: Short Goblin Cleaver
zikka_cleaver.description: A short, heavy cleaver with a chipped edge and a grip wrapped in old cord.

zikka_hooked_knife.name: Hooked Knife
zikka_hooked_knife.description: A curved knife whose hooked point is made for hooking and tearing.

zikka_backup_knife.name: Zikka's Backup Knife
zikka_backup_knife.description: A flat little knife carried out of sight against the small of the back, the kind you reach for only when the first weapon is gone. Nobody who has seen Zikka fight has seen this one.

zikka_whetstone.name: Whetstone
zikka_whetstone.description: A palm-sized grey stone, hollowed in the middle by years of sharpening.

zikka_bone_necklace.name: Bone Necklace
zikka_bone_necklace.description: A cord of drilled knucklebones, each one a name Zikka has not forgotten.

zikka_trophy_tags.name: Trophy Tags
zikka_trophy_tags.description: A jingling cluster of tags, teeth and buckles taken from the fallen.

mikka_work_vest.name: Pocket Work Vest
mikka_work_vest.description: A vest bristling with pockets and loops, every one holding a tool.

mikka_work_trousers.name: Work Trousers
mikka_work_trousers.description: Heavy trousers patched at the knee and singed at the cuff.

mikka_fingerless_gloves.name: Fingerless Gloves
mikka_fingerless_gloves.description: Fingerless gloves worn thin, cut away so no fingertip is ever dulled.

mikka_scrap_plates.name: Scrap-Metal Plates
mikka_scrap_plates.description: Plates of salvaged metal riveted onto the vest over heart and ribs.

mikka_prybar_dagger.name: Improvised Pry-Bar Dagger
mikka_prybar_dagger.description: A flattened iron bar ground to a point at one end and hooked at the other.

mikka_hammer.name: Goblin Hammer
mikka_hammer.description: A chipped hammer that has opened more locks than it has driven nails.

mikka_pliers.name: Bent Pliers
mikka_pliers.description: Pliers worn smooth at the jaw, good for wire, teeth and stubborn rivets.

mikka_wrench.name: Stolen Wrench
mikka_wrench.description: A human wrench, its maker's mark filed away and its jaw polished by use.
mikka_wrench.provenance: Stolen from a human wagon on the old road.

mikka_lockpicks.name: Lockpicks
mikka_lockpicks.description: A rolled leather sleeve of picks, tension wrenches and one bent into a hook.

mikka_copper_earrings.name: Copper Earrings
mikka_copper_earrings.description: A row of hammered copper rings up one ear, each one traded or won.

mikka_gears.name: Loose Gears
mikka_gears.description: A tin of gears and cogs, most of them from mechanisms nobody here can name.

gribba_butchers_apron.name: Butcher's Apron
gribba_butchers_apron.description: A heavy apron stiff with old blood and grease, worn like a badge of office.
gribba_butchers_apron.provenance: Taken from an abandoned farm on the way to the camp.

gribba_leather_clothes.name: Loose Leather Clothes
gribba_leather_clothes.description: Loose leather clothing cut for long hours over a fire, not for running.

gribba_head_wrap.name: Cloth Head Wrap
gribba_head_wrap.description: A strip of clean cloth wound over the brow to keep sweat and hair from the pot.

gribba_forearm_guards.name: Thick Leather Forearm Guards
gribba_forearm_guards.description: Thick hide guards laced up the forearms, scorched where they have turned a spill.

gribba_butchers_knife.name: Heavy Butcher's Knife
gribba_butchers_knife.description: A broad-bladed knife kept sharp enough to part a joint in one draw.

gribba_meat_hook.name: Meat Hook
gribba_meat_hook.description: A heavy iron hook, its point honed and its grip wrapped in cord.

gribba_cooking_spoon.name: Cooking Spoon
gribba_cooking_spoon.description: A long wooden spoon, one edge of the bowl flattened into a scraper.

gribba_flint.name: Flint and Striker
gribba_flint.description: A knapped flint and a scrap of steel, kept dry in a twist of cloth.

gribba_herbs.name: Drying Herbs
gribba_herbs.description: Bundles of herbs hung to dry, sorted by what they cure rather than how they taste.

gribba_food_charms.name: Food Charms
gribba_food_charms.description: Little carved tokens strung on sinew, meant to keep a stew from turning.

rikka_asymmetric_wrap.name: Asymmetric Leather and Cloth
rikka_asymmetric_wrap.description: A wrap cut high on one side and long on the other, strips of cloth trailing.

rikka_light_leather.name: Light Leather
rikka_light_leather.description: Supple leather fitted close, cut so nothing binds when Rikka tumbles.

rikka_throwing_knives.name: Throwing Knives
rikka_throwing_knives.description: A set of balanced knives, their grips worn smooth by long practice.

rikka_performance_stick.name: Performance Stick
rikka_performance_stick.description: A short club of polished wood, more often spun than swung.

rikka_juggling_stones.name: Juggling Stones
rikka_juggling_stones.description: A set of smooth stones matched by weight, their surfaces polished by catching.

rikka_string_puppet.name: String Puppet
rikka_string_puppet.description: A jointed puppet of bone and cloth on a tangle of strings.

rikka_little_drum.name: Little Drum
rikka_little_drum.description: A hand drum of stretched hide over a bent frame, pitch changed with a thumb.

rikka_bells.name: Tangle of Bells
rikka_bells.description: Dozens of mismatched bells knotted to a cord, tuned only by accident.

rikka_beads.name: Assorted Beads
rikka_beads.description: A pouch of beads in bone, clay and glass, ready to be strung or traded.

rikka_cheap_jewelry.name: Cheap Jewelry
rikka_cheap_jewelry.description: A fistful of bright, worthless jewelry, chosen for how it catches firelight.

vekka_layered_leather.name: Close-Fitting Layered Leather
vekka_layered_leather.description: Layers of supple leather fitted close, quiet and warm in the cold.

vekka_hooded_cloak.name: Hooded Cloak
vekka_hooded_cloak.description: A weather-stained cloak whose hood can swallow the whole face.

vekka_thin_guards.name: Thin Forearm and Knee Guards
vekka_thin_guards.description: Thin plates of boiled leather laced over forearms and knees.

vekka_hunting_bow.name: Vekka's Hunting Bow
vekka_hunting_bow.description: A compact hunting bow of dark goblin make, short enough to carry through scrub and strung light for a quick draw. Vekka keeps it close and does not lend it.

vekka_curved_knife.name: Curved Knife
vekka_curved_knife.description: A curved skinning knife, the belly of the blade worked thin as a leaf.

vekka_small_mirror.name: Small Mirror
vekka_small_mirror.description: A little steel mirror, better for signaling and peering round corners than for vanity.
vekka_small_mirror.provenance: Traded from a human scout for a pouch of river stones.

vekka_folded_map.name: Folded Map
vekka_folded_map.description: A map folded to a palm, the trails inked in a careful, foreign hand.

vekka_charcoal.name: Charcoal Sticks
vekka_charcoal.description: Fingers of charcoal wrapped in a leaf, for marking trails nobody else should read.

vekka_found_stones.name: Found Stones
vekka_found_stones.description: A pouch of odd river stones, kept for their color or their ring when struck.

krikka_fitted_leather.name: Lightweight Fitted Leather
krikka_fitted_leather.description: Light leather fitted like a second skin, cut short at every joint.

krikka_reinforced_palms.name: Reinforced Palms
krikka_reinforced_palms.description: Hide palms reinforced with scrap plate, proof against rope burn and stone.

krikka_climbing_guards.name: Climbing Knee and Ankle Guards
krikka_climbing_guards.description: Padded guards strapped over knee and ankle, scraped white by the cliff.

krikka_hooked_blade.name: Small Hooked Blade
krikka_hooked_blade.description: A short blade with a deep hook, made to catch a hold as much as a throat.

krikka_backup_knife.name: Climber's Backup Knife
krikka_backup_knife.description: A stubby knife wedged where a harness strap hides it from a casual eye.

krikka_climbing_rope.name: Climbing Rope
krikka_climbing_rope.description: A long rope knotted at intervals, each knot tested by somebody who survived it.

krikka_harness.name: Climbing Harness
krikka_harness.description: A web of straps and scavenged buckles that holds a climber to the rope.

krikka_resin.name: Pine Resin
krikka_resin.description: A lump of sticky pine resin, chewed, burned, or smeared on rope for grip.

krikka_hidden_pouch.name: Krikka's Hidden Pouch
krikka_hidden_pouch.description: A small leather pouch tucked inside a jacket and tied shut, kept out of sight and out of reach. It holds the shiniest things Krikka has found and will not admit to.

krikka_shiny_stones.name: Shiny Stones
krikka_shiny_stones.description: A double handful of glossy stones, ranked by shine on a scale only Krikka knows.
